user.title: Add Device to Time Off
user.description: Select the device you want to manage. This integration will automatically turn it off after the duration you set.

abort.already_configured: This device is already being managed by another Time Off instance.

start_timer.name: Start/Reset Timer
start_timer.description: Manually starts or resets the timer for a device managed by Time Off.

entity_id.name: Target Device
entity_id.description: The device entity that Time Off is managing (e.g. light.porch_light, fan.bathroom_fan). This is the original device, NOT the Time Off sensor or switch.

stop_timer.name: Stop/Cancel Timer
stop_timer.description: Stops the active timer immediately without turning the device off and without firing the timer_expired event.

entity_id.name: Target Device
entity_id.description: The device entity that Time Off is managing (e.g. light.porch_light, fan.bathroom_fan). This is the original device, NOT the Time Off sensor or switch.

set_off_after.name: Set Off After
set_off_after.description: Immediately restarts the timer with a new duration, without changing the Time Off default. If minutes is 0, the timer is stopped.

entity_id.name: Target Device
entity_id.description: The device entity that Time Off is managing (e.g. light.porch_light, fan.bathroom_fan). This is the original device, NOT the Time Off sensor or switch.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: The new duration in minutes (0 to 1440). Set to 0 to stop the timer immediately.
